%   server_id,
%   team_id,
%   channel_id,
%   user_id,
%   post_id,
%   root_id,
%   event_timestamp,
%   cursor,
%   seen_posts,       % list of post_ids for duplicate suppression
%   effect_ids,       % list of effect_ids for idempotency suppression
%   panic_active      % boolean
% )

:- dynamic state/1.

% Initialize state with default values
init_state(State) :-
    State = state(
        'server-1',
        'team-1',
        'channel-1',
        'user-1',
        'post-1',
        'root-1',
        0,
        0,
        [],
        [],
        false
    ).

% Ensure state exists
ensure_state(State) :-
    (   state(State) -> true
    ;   init_state(State), assert(state(State))
    ).

% Update state
update_state(State) :-
    retractall(state(_)),
    assert(state(State)).

% surface_ingest/5
% surface_ingest(ServerId, TeamId, ChannelId, UserId, PostId) -> Result
% Authorization precedes event construction.
% Duplicate suppression: if post_id already seen, return duplicate.
% Preserves stable identities.

surface_ingest(ServerId, TeamId, ChannelId, UserId, PostId, Result) :-
    ensure_state(State),
    % Authorization check: all IDs must be non-empty atoms
    (   (   atom(ServerId), atom(TeamId), atom(ChannelId), atom(UserId), atom(PostId),
            ServerId \= '', TeamId \= '', ChannelId \= '', UserId \= '', PostId \= ''
        )
    ->  % Check duplicate
        (   member(PostId, SeenPosts)
        ->  Result = duplicate
        ;   % Update state with new post
            State = state(S, T, C, U, P, R, TS, Cursor, Seen, Effects, Panic),
            NewSeen = [PostId | Seen],
            NewState = state(ServerId, TeamId, ChannelId, UserId, PostId, RootId, EventTS, NewCursor, NewSeen, Effects, Panic),
            % Preserve existing root_id and timestamp if not provided, use defaults
            (   atom(R), R \= ''
            ->  RootId = R
            ;   RootId = 'root-1'
            ),
            (   number(TS), TS > 0
            ->  EventTS = TS
            ;   EventTS = 0
            ),
            (   number(Cursor), Cursor > 0
            ->  NewCursor = Cursor
            ;   NewCursor = 0
            ),
            update_state(NewState),
            Result = ingested
        )
    ;   Result = unauthorized
    ).

% surface_effect/5
% surface_effect(ServerId, TeamId, ChannelId, UserId, EffectId) -> Result
% Outbound idempotency: if effect_id already seen, return suppressed.
% Panic denial: if panic is active, return panic_denied.

surface_effect(ServerId, TeamId, ChannelId, UserId, EffectId, Result) :-
    ensure_state(State),
    State = state(S, T, C, U, P, R, TS, Cursor, Seen, Effects, Panic),
    % Check panic first
    (   Panic == true
    ->  Result = panic_denied
    ;   % Check authorization
        (   (   atom(ServerId), atom(TeamId), atom(ChannelId), atom(UserId), atom(EffectId),
                ServerId \= '', TeamId \= '', ChannelId \= '', UserId \= '', EffectId \= ''
            )
        ->  % Check idempotency
            (   member(EffectId, Effects)
            ->  Result = suppressed
            ;   % Update state with new effect
                NewEffects = [EffectId | Effects],
                NewState = state(S, T, C, U, P, R, TS, Cursor, Seen, NewEffects, Panic),
                update_state(NewState),
                Result = effect_sent
            )
        ;   Result = unauthorized
        )
    ).

% surface_reconnect/2
% surface_reconnect(Cursor, Result) -> Result
% Monotone cursor: new cursor must be >= current cursor.
% If cursor is less than current, return stale_cursor.

surface_reconnect(NewCursor, Result) :-
    ensure_state(State),
    State = state(S, T, C, U, P, R, TS, CurrentCursor, Seen, Effects, Panic),
    (   number(NewCursor)
    ->  (   NewCursor >= CurrentCursor

            update_state(NewState),
            Result = reconnected
        ;   Result = stale_cursor
        )
    ;   Result = invalid_cursor
    ).

% surface_panic/2
% surface_panic(Reason, Result) -> Result
% Fixed local panic: sets panic_active to true.
% Panic denial: subsequent effects are denied.

surface_panic(Reason, Result) :-
    ensure_state(State),
    State = state(S, T, C, U, P, R, TS, Cursor, Seen, Effects, _),
    (   atom(Reason), Reason \= ''
    ->  NewState = state(S, T, C, U, P, R, TS, Cursor, Seen, Effects, true),
        update_state(NewState),
        Result = panic_active
    ;   Result = invalid_reason
    ).
